title: Chapter 1460
text:
The surging Pugilist flames burned, and the Tree God's movements became even faster. Its strength increased greatly, and it suddenly grabbed the Emperor Skysplitter Blade. It stopped the blade's momentum and stopped it in midair.

At the same time, roots shot out from the surface of the Tree God's body. The ends curled up as if they were tied into a knot. They were like thousands of fists, launching a flurry of attacks at the Supreme Heavenly Venerate's mecha.

The 'fist shadows' that flickered with green light pierced through the combined shield of the Mech Legion and bombarded the Supreme Heavenly Venerate's mecha. It shook non-stop and cracks appeared everywhere.

Energy shot out from the back of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate again and again, creating a green shockwave that did not weaken at all. It shattered the battleships behind it.

"My close combat ability has increased greatly. This should be the sacrifice of the Subduing Tree King's crown, right?"

Han Xiao felt the impact on his mecha and analyzed calmly.

He had seen [Tree King Crown-Liberation] when he was extracting the Tree God's ability. The last time they fought, the Tree God had not used this skill, and he only saw it this time.

Now that he saw the actual effect, Han Xiao felt a sense of familiarity. He felt that this move was a little like a Character Summon Card, used to obtain the power of the Super system stored in different Tree King Crowns.

"The World Tree has a total of five … Oh no, it's now four Tree King Crowns. This means that the Tree God can unleash at least four more times. Its strength will continue to stack, and its final combat strength will probably be very shocking. Furthermore, this is not considering whether the Tree God has other explosive abilities."

Han Xiaoxin quickly calculated.

When the Tree God used its one-time explosive ability, the best way was to avoid it. However, the situation did not allow it … The Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device was one-way. If he wanted to teleport the majority of the troops back, he would have to set up a new group of teleportation devices here. Now that the majority of the troops were already locked in battle with the World Tree, they naturally would not retreat halfway. Otherwise, many soldiers would have sacrificed themselves for nothing.

Furthermore, Han Xiao also wanted to fight the Tree God head-on. After all, with his current level, it was already difficult to find an opponent. It was not easy to meet one, so how could he not dote on it?

"Looks like I have to show more of my true abilities. Let me see how many tricks you have."

Han Xiao's eyes flashed with lightning.

He had long known that the Tree God had an explosive ability, but the Ancestral Tree King thought that he did not know and wanted to give him an unexpected attack. However, he had long been on guard.

On the other side, the Ancestral Tree King held onto the Emperor Skysplitter Blade tightly, not allowing Han Xiao's weapon to escape his control. An endless amount of energy surged out from his body, and he actually had the upper hand against the Supreme Heavenly Venerate, pushing Han Xiao back.

Taking advantage of the fact that Han Xiao could not move, the Ancestral Tree King controlled a large number of roots to attack the Supreme Heavenly Venerate's chest and abdomen.

The Mech Legion also reacted and began to continuously block the Tree God's attacks. At the same time, the mechanical particles flowing on the surface of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate's body transformed into streaks of silk, intercepting the roots midway and attacking them continuously.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

From afar, countless blurry afterimages of light appeared beside the two Transcendent Grade Supers. They interweaved and collided with each other. Metal and tree roots clashed at a high frequency, and endless shockwaves exploded in midair.

"Your strength is already below mine!"

The Ancestral Tree King's expression was fierce. He twisted the Emperor Skysplitter Blade and poured his strength into his arm.

However, at this moment, an unstoppable and terrifying force suddenly came from the blade, instantly suppressing his strength!

Boom!

The next moment, the Emperor Skysplitter Blade, which was originally frozen in midair, suddenly broke through the Tree God's posture and slashed down. In an instant, it slashed all the way from the Tree God's shoulder to his waist, leaving a huge wound. The Tree God was almost cut in half.

"What?!"

The Ancestral Tree King was shocked. Instead of retreating, he rushed forward and hugged Han Xiao. He wanted to use the strength of the Crown to control Han Xiao and stop his subsequent attacks.

However, the result was far from what he had imagined. The Tree God was pressed down by the Supreme Heavenly Venerate and was almost dismembered … The power brought by sacrificing the Pugilist Crown was actually suppressed by Han Xiao!

The Ancestral Tree King was horrified. It was not easy for him to detonate his Pugilist flames and escape. The Tree God's body was already in tatters, and countless pieces of his newly born flesh had been cut off. He was recovering.

Han Xiao casually cut off the World Tree Root that was blocking his pursuit. He looked at the Tree God from afar and clicked his tongue in dissatisfaction.

"You're so arrogant, but in the end, you're only at this level?"

"You …"

Sensing Han Xiao's increasing Energy Rank, the Ancestral Tree King's expression darkened.

He thought that after using the Crown, he would be able to gain the upper hand, but reality gave him a big slap. He did not expect that he would still not be Han Xiao's match after activating his SEED. The other party's combat strength was also increasing.

The Ancestral Tree King gritted his teeth and made a decision.

"Don't be happy too early. I haven't reached my limit yet!"

As soon as he said that, the Secret Tree King's Crown shattered!

New origin energy was released. It was as if fuel had been added to the core furnace of the Tree God, and his Energy Rank broke through the limit again!

Countless mysterious magic knowledge surged into his brain. At the same time, large amounts of complicated magic circuits appeared on the surface of the Tree God's body, forming enchantment runes.

In an instant, the power of the Magic Crown was also added to the Tree God's body!

The Tree God Domain expanded once again, almost flattening the Ethereal Domain!

"Ahhhhh!"

An even stronger burden descended, and the Ancestral Tree King's mental strength soared once again. However, at the same time, it brought him even more intense pain. His soul let out an uncontrollable wail, and his emotions intensified.

He endured the excruciating pain, mobilized the new energy, and launched an even stronger attack toward Han Xiao.

Rumble!

The surging magic formed a dense cluster of forbidden spells, which almost drained all the free energy in the surrounding battlefield. They turned into a strong rainbow light and drowned Han Xiao's entire body in an instant. Amidst the brilliance, there was an extremely lethal aura.

The Tree God maintained the magic bombardment while charging into the light of the explosion, chasing after the body of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate. His fists and roots that contained astonishing Pugilist flames landed on Han Xiao's body continuously, producing loud explosions!

The Ancestral Tree King stared with bloodshot eyes and attacked tirelessly!

"Black Star! I will never let you destroy my civilization! "

The roar of his mind swept across the battlefield, instantly causing the expressions of countless people to change!

However, at this moment, a dense aura of blood suddenly erupted in front of him.

Buzz!

Before the Ancestral Tree King could react, a cold light suddenly lit up. He felt a huge force coming from his chest, and the Emperor Skysplitter Blade flew over and stabbed into his chest.

The next second, the Ancestral Tree King realized that his arm was firmly fixed. Not only that, but all the roots that were hit suddenly stopped and could not be pulled out.

The light of the magic bombardment dissipated, revealing the appearance of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate. Han Xiao was surrounded by blood aura as he grabbed the Tree God's arm. Mechanical particles formed countless tentacles that extended out from his back and accurately wrapped around every World Tree Root. They froze in midair like bridges.

The strength of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate increased rapidly and soon surpassed the second stage of the Tree God's Crown Liberation, making the Ancestral Tree King unable to break free.

"You …"

The Ancestral Tree King's eyes widened.

However, before he could do anything, Han Xiao suddenly headbutted him, making him dizzy.

Immediately after, the Supreme Heavenly Venerate grabbed the Tree God's arm and pressed him down. At the same time, he bent his knee and raised his leg, smashing the Tree God's head with a violent knee strike, causing a green shockwave to explode. Then, Han Xiao reached out and stabbed his hand into the gap in the Tree God's head, all the way to his chest. He grabbed a bunch of messy roots and pulled them out, pulling out a large number of broken roots.

If it was a normal life form, its spine and internal organs would have been pulled out. Even the Tree God, who had a special body structure, would not feel good.

At this moment, Han Xiao pulled out the Emperor Skysplitter Blade that was stabbed into the Tree God's chest. He then used Virtual Creation to create countless physical cannons around him and aimed them at the Tree God.

Rumble — —

A round of shots, which were equivalent to the mass of an unknown number of planets, directly blasted the Tree God into a pulp, sending wood chips flying everywhere.

The terrifying kinetic energy pushed the Tree God out, creating a blank area on the battlefield. Han Xiao followed closely behind and rushed all the way to the middle of the third layer of defense.

It was only then that the Ancestral Tree King stopped retreating. He teleported and hurriedly avoided Han Xiao's pursuit. He jumped a distance away and quickly summoned more World Tree Roots to heal his injuries.

Seeing this, Han Xiao swung his blade and casually said:

"That's it? Is there more? "

In terms of the quantity and quality of his attribute enhancement abilities, very few people could defeat him. The Tree God had activated his seed twice in a row, and his combat strength had increased by a lot, but it was still not enough in front of him.

Although he had not been a Transcendent for long, as long as he activated all the bonuses, his combat strength could jump to a very shocking level. Han Xiao was not sure what level he was at among the Transcendent Grade Supers when he used his full strength.

Hearing this, the Ancestral Tree King became more and more agitated. Anger, shock, and unwillingness filled his mind.

He had sacrificed two Tree King Crowns and paid such a huge price, but his combat strength was still inferior to Black Star's?!

The Ancestral Tree King was already in a difficult position. To him, a stalemate was meaningless. If he could not kill Black Star, the other party would be able to make a comeback countless times. There was only one way out now, and that was to kill Black Star at all costs.

All sorts of thoughts flashed through his mind. The Ancestral Tree King looked at the mother tree's main body with determination in his eyes.

Seeing that the Ancestral Tree King did not reply, Han Xiao was about to continue attacking, but at this moment, the World Tree fleet around him charged toward him like crazy.

"Protect the mother tree!"

"Go, buy time for the Tree God to catch his breath!"

"Fight for our home!"

Countless World Tree warriors roared and fought.

Seeing this, Han Xiao casually waved his firepower. The nearby fleets were all wiped out, and new troops filled in. Many World Tree soldiers sacrificed their lives to form a line of defense, stopping him from chasing after the Tree God. They only wanted to buy one more second for the severely injured Tree God to recover.

However, in front of the absolute difference in strength, the determination to face death was meaningless. No matter how many fleets there were, they would all be wiped out by the psionic waves.

Countless World Tree Blessed Race swarmed over like moths to a flame, leaving behind the 'corpses' of the paralyzed battleships. There was only dead silence in the ship, and the crew had all been killed by the psionic waves.

Han Xiao was not obstructed at all. He stepped on the corpses of countless World Tree battleships and pointed at the severely injured Tree God. The huge figure of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate emitted an aura that made one despair.

Seeing this tragic scene, many of the players who were in the midst of battle were moved.

"They should be evenly matched, but why do I feel like it's an adult bullying a child …"

"Look at Black Star's style. I'm a little confused. Which one is the villain?"

"Come on, big brother who plays with tree roots!"

Amidst the cheers of the players, Han Xiao crashed into the Tree God, who had yet to fully recover, and pushed him forward.

The Tree God seemed to have lost the ability to resist and could not stop Han Xiao's footsteps at all. The two of them tangled together and broke through the third and fourth layers of defense. Not long after, they reached the innermost fifth layer of defense. The main body of the World Tree that supported this dimension was still right in front of them.

The gazes of the Galactic Alliance Army and the World Tree fleet were all focused on them. Seeing Black Star approaching the World Tree's main body, everyone's hearts were in their mouths.

However, at this moment, the Tree God's green domain suddenly expanded.

Buzz!

Green light flashed and enveloped the two of them. Then, it shrank into light spots and disappeared.

The two of them were swallowed and disappeared from the battlefield in front of everyone. All the detection devices lost track of them.

This scene was out of the expectations of the Galactic Alliance Army. Countless people's hearts shrank, and they were flustered and confused, not knowing what had happened.

At the same time, in the strategic command center of the Galactic Alliance Army.

Simon pounced on the table agitatedly. His eyes widened as he stared at the signal point that had disappeared from the sand table. He could not hide his shock.

"Where's Black Star? Where's the big Black Star? Where did the two of them go? "
